title: Barnaby at eight, ii
logline: Tuesday. The gray. One hair. Wood finds it on the dog's chin and the strip gives the hair a panel, and then gives the dog's whole face a panel so the reader can see it's one.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD on the floor with BARNABY, scratching the chin. Stopping.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man sitting on a garage floor scratching a dog's chin and stopping suddenly, no words

panels.composition: One gray hair. On the chin. The panel is the hair.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, extreme close-up of a single gray hair among dark fur on a dog's chin
image.notes: One hair. The panel is the hair.

panels.composition: The dog's whole face. The hair somewhere on it. The reader looks for it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a middle-aged dog's whole face with a single gray hair somewhere on the chin, no words

panels.composition: Wood, not saying it. Scratching the chin again. The dog's eyes closed. The strip closing its own.
